summary: DELIVERABLE: scripts/verify/cranial-nerve-courses.mjs (38,425 B, new, committed) — the task's required gate — reads the twelve authored cranial-nerve COURSE records and asserts, per nerve and with every number printed: >= 3 finite waypoints; tubeRadius finite, > 0, equal to calibre_mm / 2.4 at 1 au = 1.2 mm and equal to the PLAN.md §3.4 table (3.0/1.0/4.5/1.9/1.9/2.8/2.0/2.4/1.5/1.8/1.7/4.0 mm -> 1.25/0.42/1.88/0.79/0.79/1.17/0.83/1.00/0.63/0.75/0.71/1.67 au); the nerve's own exit landmark carried as a LITERAL waypoint (measured deviation 0.000 au for all ten nerves that have one, tolerance 2.0 au); the documented foramen named in the record AND a substring of the nerve record's own committed course sentence; every waypoint inside CLIP_BOUNDS (read from viewer3d/clipPlanes.ts) with a printed minimum clearance (achieved 6.00 au, at CN I [11,9,66] against z=+72); a total path length in au and mm; no duplicate ids; and the required direction/modality/origin/target/decussation/function/clinical/levels/refs content. 220 assertions, 0 failed, exit 0. It also EXECUTES the rendering claims rather than reading comments: the 23 tracts plus the 12 courses through the shipped isTractVisible (tract-kind gating verified to read the record's own registry kind, with hasNerveCourse(id) true for exactly the 12 nerve ids and false for a real tract, and the structure pass dropping a record that has a course so no blob is drawn), and it slices each course's tube with the section worker's REAL machinery (three TubeGeometry at TractTube's own 72x10 sweep, then contours.boundsMayCut + contours.extractContours) printing the loop count per crossing plane: 576 crossing planes and 689 contour loops across the twelve (per-axis tables printed), so the 2D live section and the PiP do receive nerve contours. ANCHORING: the ten nerves with a committed exit landmark (surf-cn3-exit .. surf-cn12-exit) carry that landmark at 0.000 au and start on their committed nucleus origin3d; CN XI starts on nuc-ambiguus and passes surf-cn11-exit; CN I has no brainstem root and no surf-cn1-exit, so its chain runs epithelium [11,9,66] -> bulb and ENDS on the record's own committed origin3d [8,12,48] (0.000 au); CN II has no root either and is anchored on committed geometry — the ends of the committed tract-optic-nerve polyline [11,19,33] and [2,23.5,23.5], each at 0.000 au, with the interior committed points report-bounded at 6.595 au and the first waypoint [26,16,57] on the measured tract-optic-nerve GLB extent (z 16.7..63.2 au, 55.8 mm, which the 50.9 mm chain matches within 9%). Every record's anchorNote carries the honesty statement (asserted in both halves with the three shipped phrasings). WHERE THE DATA LIVES — THE ONE DEVIATION FROM THE DISPATCH, MADE FROM MEASUREMENT: the brief named src/data/tracts.json as the course container and the task scope lists it as writable. I BUILT that first and MEASURED it: (1) reusing the nerve ids (nrv-cn3-oculomotor ...) for a second record is a hard validator failure — 24 errors, 'duplicate id ... duplicate display name', because validate-data.mjs claimIdentity keeps ONE id ledger across structures/ and tracts.json; (2) giving the courses their own ids (tract-cn*-course) instead needs 12 new registry rows and STILL duplicates the render, because the twelve courses already ship as the single source of truth in src/geometry/curves.ts (NERVE_COURSES: id/name/region/kind:'nerve'/direction/foramen/anchorId/anchorNote/waypoints/tubeRadius/calibreMm/clinical/refs), which the parallel course-render and section-nerve tasks import for the 3D tube pass (SceneLayers) and for SECTION_NERVE_PARTS (the 12 procedural 2D parts). A second table in tracts.json would have drawn every course twice and put the courses in the Tracts collection, where the 'Cranial nerves' toggle does not reach them. I therefore WITHDREW src/data/tracts.json and src/data/taxonomy.json to their pre-existing committed state (git diff for tracts.json is EMPTY, and the taxonomy diff is exactly the v13 slice's 12 rows + 1 trailing comma) and made the gate assert the shipped table through the repo's own TS loader hook — which is strictly stronger, because it verifies the data the two surfaces actually render. The gate documents the migration point (NerveCourseRecord -> src/types.ts, NERVE_COURSES -> src/data/structures/nerve-courses.json, load.ts exports nerveCourses, two consumers swap their import) for the data-core task that owns those files; nothing in the gate would change. COSTS AND HONESTY: no mesh, no GLB and no manifest part was added (138 manifest parts, 599,204 tris, GLB 13.82 MiB of 14 — re-measured by verify:pipeline and verify:budget-report, both exit 0), the 12 tubes are procedural (9,636 verts / 17,280 triangles for 12 tubes, cache-shared with the 2D section), and no committed tract gained a course/foramen/nerve field (asserted). NOT DONE, STATED: the twelve StructureRecords' own contextNote still describes the schematic ellipsoid — the authored-path statement lives in each course's anchorNote instead, and rewriting those two files was outside this task's write scope.
